description: Worked closely with other company executives to identify new business opportunities, securing contracts for enterprise government software, Software as a Service (SaaS), Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS), and Managed Service solutions. New business development to capture market share for second mortgage wholesale lending in South Carolina. Assisted mortgage brokers and bankers to allow them to maximize revenue per loan and optimize customer relationship.
Provided full service business relationship management to leverage all of the deposit, investment, and lending portfolio of the bank.
Business development for Software as a Service (SaaS), managed services, Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP), hardware, and telephony for mid-tier market

matchmaking_summary: The candidate presents a robust profile as a results-driven and skilled Business Development Executive. With over a decade of experience in the public sector, technology, and financial sectors, they have demonstrated expertise in strategic account development, relationship selling, team building, and analytical problem solving. Their track record includes substantial achievements such as increasing territory penetration by 25%, managing accounts totaling millions in annual sales, and generating pipeline opportunities exceeding $150 million in net new opportunities within a year. The candidate's ability to develop effective strategies for customer growth and revenue expansion is noteworthy, showcasing strong leadership and analytical skills.
